properties.name: Where the design holds one fact in more than one place — two stored copies, a surface mirrored in another design, a quantity stated in two places — how far the copies disagree is measured and located edge by edge, and reported as a reading, not only flagged

properties.statement:
For every fact reflow2 holds in more than one place — a relationship stored both as an edge and as a pointer property, a surface mirrored between designs, a quantity stated both on a part and as its contribution to a budget — the design reports HOW FAR the copies disagree and WHERE: for categorical copies, which copies disagree; for numeric ones, the size of each disagreement, summed per fact and per part. It is reported as a reading with the copies behind it and never silently repaired; which copy is authoritative is the declared authority's business, not this measure's.

Method: a sheaf over the graph (Gebhart, Hansen & Schrater, "Knowledge Sheaves", AISTATS 2023) — each place a fact is held is a local view, each link between places says how they should agree, and the Laplacian Σ‖F_u x_u − F_v x_v‖² scores total disagreement and names the edges that carry it. With identity maps it is a sum of squared differences; for categorical facts it reduces to counting disagreements, and nothing more elaborate is built for them.

Serves tests 2(i) and 5 of the accepted definition of a true knowledge graph (graph-primitives design: dec:what-a-true-knowledge-graph-is). Priority low: in reflow2 most duplicated facts are categorical, so the measure mostly counts; it earns more in StoryFlow, where perspectives carry numeric dimension scores.
